Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: Misidentified George II of Waldeck-Pyrmont’s mother by relying on a search snippet and confusing generations—stating she was Christiane Henriette of Nassau-Siegen (who was actually his grandmother). This genealogical misreading (and lack of source verification) introduced the first factual error.
